_about: SROM house style v3 (29.09.2026) — the one definition of the InDesign styles: srom_style_setup.jsx, config/styles.json and references/style-sheet.md derive from it. Values are the vol. 18 (2025) templates' own (03_Ellis, 09_Konferencja, read in InDesign), not invented; deliberate changes are listed per style under 'changes'. Units pt. Page 165×235 mm. Body 10.5/13 on the 13.2945 pt baseline grid (start 62.362 pt from the top of the page) — kept for continuity with 18 volumes. Property names are InDesign scripting names; enumerations are written as their constant (LEFT_JUSTIFIED).

document._notes: noSplitting false = a long note may run over to the next page (as Ellis; MB 29.09.2026). The number in the note is superscript through the Przypis nested style (Indeks górny through the 1-line drop cap), followed by the separator '.' + en space; the number in the text is superscript by markerPositioning.
